propositions: Every plan-review gate change lands on live dogfood reviews without a standing offline instrument to measure improvement or regression before shipping.

The corpus of 4,300+ plan_review_result_v2 sidecars with outcome labels exists but is scattered; a unified harness is needed to replay Pass-1/Pass-2/Pass-3 changes in isolation under a hard $200 Bedrock budget with model parity and prompt caching.

Pass-3 changes (formula, threshold, routing) can be assessed over the entire corpus with zero LLM calls by replaying the deterministic decide kernel; Pass-2 and Pass-1 changes require tiered LLM re-runs (Sonnet and Opus respectively) on fixed samples, priced and budgeted with a committed ledger.
Prompt caching has been disabled since 2026-08-12 due to a mixed Bedrock+Anthropic provider chain, and ticket attribution is missing from usage_log records, both blocking accurate cost measurement.

A reviewer-noise floor from 208 identical-material verdict flips and a Tier-1 reproduction run must gate acceptance; changes are reported as regressing/improving only when label-proxy deltas exceed the noise band.

The harness must enforce model-parity constraints (production model class per pass, Bedrock only, homogeneous provider chain) and refuse to diff runs or start evals if model ids differ from corpus baseline or if a proposed change is cheaper than the production model.
